stem.text: Which statement correctly describes the association between a companion cell and its sieve tube cell?

A.text: The companion cell provides all of the ATP used for energy-requiring processes in both types of cell.

B.text: The companion cell controls the active transport of molecules through the sieve plates.

C.text: The companion cell prevents side-to-side movement of assimilates between sieve tube cells.

D.text: The companion cell provides a nucleus that controls cellular activities in both types of cell.
